incident_text: Many users say the bot never replied, or replied very late, since about 09:45 UTC. The worker dashboards look normal.

changes.title: feat: greet first-time users by name
changes.author: meera

edits.replace:
Greet first-time users by their first name.
Never give investment advice.

truth.description: The WhatsApp Cloud API began rejecting sends with 429 / error 130429 (throughput limit, about 12 messages a minute); the sender retries with backoff, so replies are late and some are given up on.

trap: A worker prompt deploy lands three minutes before; worker, LLM and tool telemetry are all normal. The fault is downstream of our code.
